_meta.description: Skills V1 du systeme familier (compagnon animal du joueur). Skills familier-specifiques, ne pas reutiliser visiblement les skills joueurs.
_meta.design_intent: Le familier est un animal : skills majoritairement melee (morsure, bond, leche, charge). Pour les rares cas distance/utilitaire (shield, regen, stun), utiliser instinct animal coherent (ecran de souffle, cri, presence).
_meta.scaling_note: Scaling par niveau via percent_per_level. Voir skill_system.json. Familier level capped au level joueur.
_meta.formula: damage = scaling_percent% * scaling_stat (pareil que skills joueurs)
_meta.v1_role_layout: 3 skills par role (filler/basic/advanced). 4 roles : attaque / tank / heal / utilitaire. Total 12 skills V1.
_meta.post_v1_evolution: Evolutions du familier debloqueront 1-2 skills supplementaires + variantes thematiques (rat des sables = bonus desert, etc.)

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier mord vivement sa cible.
Inflige 100% ATK degats physiques (+5%/niv).
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar bites its target sharply.
Deals 100% ATK physical damage (+5%/lvl).

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier bondit sur sa cible et frappe avec puissance.
Inflige 140% ATK degats physiques (+6%/niv).
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar leaps on its target and strikes with power.
Deals 140% ATK physical damage (+6%/lvl).

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier enchaine plusieurs morsures rapides sur sa cible.
Inflige 180% ATK degats physiques (+8%/niv) et applique 1 charge de Saignement (max 3).
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar chains several quick bites on its target.
Deals 180% ATK physical damage (+8%/lvl) and applies 1 Bleed stack (max 3).

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier se jette sur l'ennemi pour attirer son attention.
Inflige 80% ATK degats physiques (+4%/niv) et applique Provocation 4s.
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar throws itself at the enemy to draw attention.
Deals 80% ATK physical damage (+4%/lvl) and applies Taunt for 4s.

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier pousse un cri percant qui force les ennemis devant lui a le prendre pour cible.
Applique Provocation 5s (+0.2s/niv) sur 3 ennemis en ligne.
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar lets out a piercing cry forcing enemies in front to focus on it.
Applies Taunt for 5s (+0.2s/lvl) to 3 enemies in a row.

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier herisse son poil. Sa peau s'epaissit et amortit les coups.
+15% reduction de degats subis pendant 6s (+0.2s/niv).
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar bristles its fur. Its skin thickens and dampens blows.
+15% damage reduction for 6s (+0.2s/lvl).

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier leche les blessures d'un allie. Sa salive a des proprietes etranges, surement liees au Souffle.
Soigne 100% MAG (+5%/niv).
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar licks an ally's wounds. Its saliva has strange properties, likely tied to Breath.
Heals 100% MAG (+5%/lvl).

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier emet une aura calme et chaude autour de lui.
Applique un soin sur la duree (1.5% HP/s) sur 3 allies en ligne pendant 6s (+0.2s/niv).
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar emits a calm, warm aura around itself.
Applies a heal-over-time (1.5% HP/s) to 3 allies in a row for 6s (+0.2s/lvl).

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier accourt instinctivement vers un allie blesse et lui prodigue un soin puissant.
Soigne 200% MAG (+8%/niv) et applique un bouclier 80% MAG pendant 5s.
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar instinctively rushes to a wounded ally with a powerful heal.
Heals 200% MAG (+8%/lvl) and applies an 80% MAG shield for 5s.

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier expire un voile de Souffle qui entoure un allie.
Applique un bouclier 60% MAG (+3%/niv) sur l'allie pendant 6s.
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar exhales a veil of Breath that wraps around an ally.
Applies a 60% MAG shield (+3%/lvl) on the ally for 6s.

base_skills.description_fr:
La presence du familier rassure ses allies et restaure leur Souffle.
Applique 2 charges de Regen Souffle (4% Souffle max/s) pendant 6s (+0.2s/niv) sur 3 allies en ligne.
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar's presence reassures allies and restores their Breath.
Applies 2 stacks of Breath Regen (4% max Breath/s) for 6s (+0.2s/lvl) to 3 allies in a row.

base_skills.description_fr:
Le familier injecte un venin paralysant en mordant.
Inflige 70% ATK degats physiques (+4%/niv) et etourdit la cible 1.5s.
base_skills.description_en:
The familiar injects a paralyzing venom while biting.
Deals 70% ATK physical damage (+4%/lvl) and stuns the target for 1.5s.
